notes:
Summary: HavenBridge is a regulated fintech (quant trading + customer-facing research assistant). Primary ask: committed Dedicated capacity with explicit throughput guarantees and clear unit economics per token. They want single-tenant VPC with KMS-managed keys and 7-year audit log retention for certain datasets.

Conversation flavor: fast-moving finance customer — ‘latency is revenue’ repeated on kickoff call. High sensitivity to tail latency and predictable per-token spend for budgeting and trading P&L attribution.

Key quotes / call snippets:
- 'We need P95 below 120ms for 32-token responses and sub-500ms for 1k-token flows if possible.'
- 'If we reserve GPUs we need transparent math: how many tokens per dollar at 70% utilization.'

Commercial posture: leaning toward 12–24 month reserved commit if perf checks out. Interested in a staged commit (small tranche now + automatic scale-up option) and rights to burst to hosted pool during peaks.

Security / compliance notes: will require SOC2 Type II evidence, remote audit window, signed BAA for certain data, and contractual clause for data residency (US only).

Attachments: pricing deck (drive link), security FAQ (drive link), perf rubric (attached in Fireflies transcript).

cost_model_summary:
POC-driven cost model (two scenarios):
Scenario A (Baseline commit): 8 H100-equivalent GPUs reserved; target utilization 65% steady-state; expected monthly token capacity ~60B tokens; blended unit cost estimate $0.0000028 per token (includes reserved capacity amortized + infra + support).
Scenario B (Aggressive commit): 16 H100-equivalent GPUs reserved; target utilization 75%; expected monthly token capacity ~140B tokens; blended unit cost estimate $0.0000019 per token.
Assumptions: avg request = 380 tokens, 24/7 production load shape with weekday peaks (40% above baseline), KV cache hit-rate 12% on prompts, batching improves throughput by ~1.9x for small responses.
Commercial levers being negotiated: minimum monthly commit, effective utilization floor for pricing tiers, built-in burst credits to hosted pool, and overage rates (market competitive but with caps).
Notes for negotiation: provide three-tier commit ladder (small/med/large) with step-up discounts, include quarterly utilization reconciliation, and a clear conversion methodology from reserved GPU hours to tokens (documented formula: tokens = GPU_hours * throughput_tokens_per_hour at measured P95 profile).
throughput_targets: Goal: sustained 1,200 concurrent sessions producing avg 380 tokens (approx 456k tokens/sec) at p95 latency < 250ms for <=512-token responses. Burst target: 2x baseline for 15-minute windows.
latency_slos: Target SLOs: p50 < 60ms, p95 < 200ms for short-chat flows (<=128 tokens). Long-form flows (<=1k tokens): p95 < 700ms. Tail mitigation: automatic fallback to smaller model for >99.9th percentile if needed.
poC_scope: 2-week Dedicated perf POC: deploy 2-node reserved pool (H100 equiv), run synthetic and replayed production traces, measure p50/p95/p99 latencies, validate KV cache efficacy, and collect token throughput curves at various batch sizes. Deliverable: perf matrix + economics reconciliation doc.
